component.notes:
Lutron LEAP Bridge — Custom Savant profile for HomeWorks QSX and RadioRA 3.
This profile connects to SplycedBoard, running on the Savant Pro Host, via HTTP on port 47200. HTTP is used (instead of TCP 8023) so that Savant can serialize bleColor data from the color wheel into URL query parameters — something TCP command strings cannot do.
Setup: 1. Install SplycedBoard on the Pro Host 2. Open http://(host):47200, Lutron LEAP, and pair with the Lutron processor 3. In Blueprint, set the Address/Host to 127.0.0.1, Port to 47200 4. Use the Lighting Data Table — Address1 = LEAP Zone ID (shown in web UI) 5. Use the Shade Data Table — Address1 = LEAP Zone ID (shade zones)
Address fields: Lighting/Shade table: Address1 = LEAP Zone ID Keypad Button entity: Address1 = LEAP Device ID, Address2 = Button Number, Address3 = LED ID (SplycedBoard's Keypads tab lists them under each keypad's "Savant addresses")
State Variables: SystemType — QSX or RA3 (informational; bridge auto-detects) FadeTime — default fade time in seconds for switch on/off actions
Status feedback: HTTP can't push, so Savant asks SplycedBoard twice a second (PollFeedback) for the levels and keypad LEDs that changed: at a keypad, in the Lutron app, in a scene, or in SplycedBoard. ZoneFeedback writes levels into DimmerLevel_(zone) and ColorLevel_(zone), the states the lighting and shade table rows show; LEDFeedback lights IsCurrentLEDOn_(device)_(LED) for Keypad Button rows. When Savant starts, FeedbackStart asks for everything again and each load is asked for its level (QueryDimmerLevel, read by ZoneLevel).
Button events, for Savant triggers: ButtonFeedback sets ButtonEvent_(device)_(button) to what a keypad button did (Press, Release, Hold, MultiTap: whichever the processor reports for that button's programming), then back to None on the next poll, so each event is a change. Device and button are Address1 and Address2 on SplycedBoard's Keypads tab, e.g. ButtonEvent_501_6. Trigger on it being equal to Release (or MultiTap…).
====================== Change Log ====================== Version 1.16 Add: keypad button events for Savant triggers. SplycedBoard's feedback answers carry button events first, and the ButtonFeedback status message sets ButtonEvent_(device)_(button) to Press, Release, Hold or MultiTap, then None. Version 1.15 Add: keypad LED feedback. SplycedBoard's feedback answers carry LEDs too, and the LEDFeedback status message lights IsCurrentLEDOn_(device)_(LED), the state a Keypad Button row shows (Address1 = device, Address2 = button, Address3 = LED, as the Keypads tab lists them). FeedbackStart asks for everything again when Savant starts. Version 1.14 Fix: status feedback, from what Savant's engine logged with 1.13. QueryDimmerLevel and QueryHVACStatus are custom component actions, where Savant looks for an entity's query_status_with_action ("Action … not found" before). ZoneFeedback's variables are declared: FeedbackZone0-31 and FeedbackLevel0-31, and DimmerLevel and ColorLevel as dynamic, one per zone ("state variable not defined: DimmerLevel_0" before). Shade entities ask QueryDimmerLevel. Version 1.13 Fix: Savant shows level changes made anywhere: keypads, the Lutron app, scenes, SplycedBoard. PollFeedback asks SplycedBoard twice a second for the levels that changed, and the ZoneFeedback status message writes them into DimmerLevel_(zone) and ColorLevel_(zone). QueryDimmerLevel's reply now says which zone it is for, and each load is asked once when Savant starts: its query_status_with_action entries were out of place, so Savant never ran them, and passed no address. QueryShadeGroupLevel asks for the level too. Version 1.12 Add: ReportProfileVersion tells SplycedBoard which profile version Savant runs, so its dashboard can warn when the profile is out of date. Fix: http_request_type moved onto command_string, where Savant's schema defines it. Version 1.11 Fix: HVAC commands use GoToDualSetPointParameters with nested DualSetPointParameters; thermostat state variables get unique_identifier="ThermostatID" so Savant can bind per-instance state to the thermostat screen. Version 1.8 Add: Palladiom thermostat support via ENV_HVACCONTROLLER_SOURCE. Version 1.9 Fix: fan modes corrected to High/Medium/Low (removed Circulate); add state variables and actions for all three. Version 1.10 Fix: add QueryDimmerLevel response parsing and query_status_with_action polling so physical keypad changes reflect in Savant app. HVAC endpoints: /api/hvac/status, /api/hvac/heat, /api/hvac/cool, /api/hvac/mode, /api/hvac/fan. Address1 = LEAP HVAC controller ID. Version 1.7 Test: Added DMX entity (DimmerSet + CurrentColor valueSource) to test whether Savant populates bleColor* args for DMX entity type. DimmerSet now includes bleColor* args and routes to /api/color. Version 1.6 Fix: Renamed entities to match Blueprint data table conventions: "Ketra Color" → "Color Slider" (Type RGBW), "Tunable White" → "CCT Slider" (Type WW). Fixed valueSource names: CurrentBleColor → ColorLevel, CurrentColorTemperature → CCTLevel. Version 1.5 Change: Migrated from TCP (port 8023) to HTTP (port 47200). All commands now use HTTP GET with query parameters. bleColorRed/Green/Blue/White now serialize correctly in URL params, enabling Ketra color wheel support. /api/color and /api/cct endpoints added to bridge. All other endpoints (zone, area, shade, scene, button) added as GET variants on port 47200. Version 1.4 Fix: RFDimmerSet sends #COLORSET with bleColor data over TCP. Version 1.3 Fix: Replaced linear Color/Vibrancy slider with color wheel. Version 1.1 Fix: resource_type attributes, shade #SHADEGRP, fan controller. Version 1.0 Initial release.
